comparison.objective: Perform a three-stage serial dilution and return the pipette.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequence pipette aspiration/dispensing across cups while preventing backward contamination.
comparison.success_condition: Three target concentrations achieved in order, no forbidden re-entry or misplaced dispensing, and empty pipette returned and released.
comparison.reason: This tests ordered liquid-transfer logic and contamination control; the candidate tests physical tool engagement, mechanical setting, and dynamic response.
